note: Triennial election of the county council, 1949: nominations 17 May 1949; the only contest was Armagh City, polled 2 June 1949. The Armagh Guardian lists give no party labels, so none are given for the unopposed members. Returned unopposed. Lindsay Henry: no party label printed in 1949. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Poyntzpass, 25 May 1939, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1939, p. 3 ("Labour to Oppose Nationalists: Armagh Co. Council Elections"); Poyntzpass, 5 June 1958, printed 'U.': Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1958, p. 4 ("Local Council Elections: No Contests for County Council")).
